topic: Facts the October 3 break test could not observe: what npm 11's allowScripts does with an uncovered install script, what esbuild's npm postinstall does and whether skipping it matters, and what engine-strict enforces
notes: Owner pages named directly: npm's documentation for the install-script policy, package.json fields, config and npm ci; esbuild's getting-started page and the npm install script's source in the esbuild repository; npm's changelog for the version the policy appeared in. Keyless, no search, seven pages. Second pass: docs.npmjs.com renders client-side and the keyless captures held only a title, so the same pages are taken from the npm repository's documentation source at the v11.19.0 tag, plus the config definitions file and the v11 release line's changelog.
